entries.text: Hey, kid. Your Pokémon look strong.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_01

entries.text: Hey, kid. Your Pokémon look strong.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_02

entries.text: You just might have what it takes to challenge\nthe Kitakami Ogre Clan.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_03

entries.text: The Kitakami Ogre Clan?
entries.label: s1_sub_017_select_01

entries.text: Who in the world...?
entries.label: s1_sub_017_select_02

entries.text: There’s a group of strong Trainers in ogre masks\nwho’ve been popping up outside the village.\r\nThey call themselves the Kitakami Ogre Clan.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_04

entries.text: They’re always on the hunt for the next battle...\nand tough kids like you are their favorite foes.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_05

entries.text: Rumor has it the Kitakami Ogre Clan’s got seven\nmembers in all...
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_06

entries.text:
If you’re gonna battle them, watch yourself.
They may be trickier to beat than you’d think.\c
I’ll give ya something cool for each member you
do manage to defeat, though.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_07

entries.text: Heard you beat a member of the Kitakami Ogre\nClan! Here’s your cool prize, as promised.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_08

entries.text: Heard you beat some members of the Kitakami\nOgre Clan! Here’re your cool prizes,\r\nas promised.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_09

entries.text: There’s just one member left... Want a hint for\nwhere they might be?
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_10

entries.text: There are [VAR 0x0200(0001)] members of the Kitakami Ogre Clan\nleft... Want a hint for where one of ’em might be?
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_11

entries.text: “Leave Oni Mountain and follow the blue. Find\nsome bamboo, and you’ll find me!”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_01

entries.text: “You will find me in a place where many gaze out\nupon the Oni’s horn.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_02

entries.text: “You will find me in the ravine beside the water\nthat flows from the Oni’s mouth.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_03

entries.text: “Trapped low down between the infernal and\na paradise, you will find me beside the water.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_04

entries.text: “You will find me in a wasteland of peculiar rocks\nin a land with no suffering.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_05

entries.text: “Upon the shorter of the Oni’s horns—that is\nwhere you will find me standing.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_06

entries.text: “Descend a hole beside a pool that is never\ndark, and you will find me.”\c\nThat’s your only hint—now go find them!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_hint_07

entries.text: And with that...it seems you’ve defeated every\nlast member of the Kitakami Ogre Clan.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_12

entries.text: With an opponent as strong as you, I think I can\nactually go all out...
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_13

entries.text: Hah!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_14

entries.text: I am the one and only secret master of the\nKitakami Ogre Clan!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_15

entries.text: The final battle is nigh. Let me know once you’ve\nprepared yourself.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_16

entries.text: One last battle with me... I trust that your\npreparations are in place?
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_17

entries.text: ... ... ...\c\nThen return when you are ready.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_18

entries.text: Let’s go somewhere more suited for battle.\nCome with me.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_30

entries.text: I am Muramasa, secret master of the Kitakami\nOgre Clan! Now...have at you!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_19

entries.text: Hahaha! So you’ve managed to defeat even me!\nI must commend your strength!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_20

entries.text: ...Hah, just kidding! Thanks for taking part in\nour little event!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_22

entries.text: You see, the Kitakami Ogre Clan is actually a\nspecial campaign we run to train up the kiddos\r\nand let ’em experience the joys of battling.
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_23

entries.text: We always hold this event around the same time\nas the Festival of Masks...
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_24

entries.text: Problem is, our members don’t know how to hold\nback, so a kid’s never made it to the end before!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_25

entries.text: I think you might be the first one to defeat me!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_26

entries.text: So here, congrats! Take this prize!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_27

entries.text: Keep up your training in the land of Kitakami.\nGrow big and strong in the great outdoors!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_28

entries.text: Well, if it isn’t the first kid to defeat me! Come\nto pay me a visit? Haha, splendid! Just splendid!
entries.label: s1_sub_017_man_29
